points.title: Write to read/write register answers OKAY
points.condition: A B transfer occurs with bresp 2'b00 for a write whose AW address selected a read/write register.

points.title: Write to status register answers OKAY
points.condition: A B transfer occurs with bresp 2'b00 for a write whose AW address selected the status register (word index 16).

points.title: Write to unmapped gap below status answers SLVERR
points.condition: A B transfer with bresp 2'b10 for a write to a word index from PARA_NUM_REGS to 15.

points.title: Write to unmapped region above status answers SLVERR
points.condition: A B transfer with bresp 2'b10 for a write to a word index 17..31.

points.title: Write with high address bit set answers SLVERR
points.condition: A B transfer with bresp 2'b10 for a write whose word index is 32 or more (a 1 in address bit 7 or above).

points.title: Read of read/write register answers OKAY
points.condition: An R transfer with rresp 2'b00 for a read whose AR address selected a read/write register.

points.title: Read of status register
points.condition: An R transfer with rresp 2'b00 for a read whose AR address selected the status register.

points.title: Read of unmapped gap below status
points.condition: An R transfer with rresp 2'b10 and rdata 0 for a read to a word index from PARA_NUM_REGS to 15.

points.title: Read of unmapped region above status
points.condition: An R transfer with rresp 2'b10 and rdata 0 for a read to a word index 17..31.

points.title: Read with high address bit set
points.condition: An R transfer with rresp 2'b10 and rdata 0 for a read whose word index is 32 or more.

points.title: Write with all strobes set to a register
points.condition: Edge Ec of a write to a read/write register with wstrb 4'b1111 taken at the W transfer.

points.title: Write with partial strobes to a register
points.condition: Edge Ec of a write to a read/write register with wstrb neither 4'b0000 nor 4'b1111.

points.title: Write with zero strobes to a register
points.condition: Edge Ec of a write to a read/write register with wstrb 4'b0000.

points.title: Write address before write data
points.condition: The W transfer occurs while the AW address is already held (Ec at the W transfer).

points.title: Write data before write address
points.condition: The AW transfer occurs while the W data is already held (Ec at the AW transfer).

points.title: AW and W at the same edge
points.condition: AW and W transfers occur at the same edge with nothing held.

points.title: Long gap: write address held 4 or more edges before data
points.condition: The W transfer occurs after the AW address was held alone for at least 3 earlier checked edges (gap of 4 or more cycles).

points.title: B transfer without back-pressure
points.condition: A B transfer occurs in the first cycle bvalid is 1 (bready already 1).

points.title: B back-pressure of at least 1 cycle
points.condition: A B transfer occurs after bvalid was 1 with bready 0 for at least 1 earlier cycle.

points.title: B back-pressure of 4 or more cycles
points.condition: A B transfer occurs after bvalid was 1 with bready 0 for at least 4 consecutive cycles.

points.title: R transfer without back-pressure
points.condition: An R transfer occurs in the first cycle rvalid is 1 (rready already 1).

points.title: R back-pressure of at least 1 cycle
points.condition: An R transfer occurs after rvalid was 1 with rready 0 for at least 1 earlier cycle.

points.title: R back-pressure of 4 or more cycles
points.condition: An R transfer occurs after rvalid was 1 with rready 0 for at least 4 consecutive cycles.

points.title: New AW or W valid presented during stalled B
points.condition: While a write response is pending with bready 0, awvalid or wvalid is 1.

points.title: New AR valid presented during stalled R
points.condition: While read data is pending with rready 0, arvalid is 1.

points.title: Back-to-back writes every 2 cycles
points.condition: AW and W transfers occur at the same edge immediately after a B transfer at the previous edge.

points.title: Back-to-back reads every 2 cycles
points.condition: An AR transfer occurs at the edge immediately after an R transfer.

points.title: Read and write of same register with Ear = Ec
points.condition: An AR transfer and the Ec of a write occur at the same edge, both for the same read/write register.

points.title: Read and write of same register with Ear = Ec-1
points.condition: Ec of a write occurs one edge after the AR transfer of a read of the same read/write register.

points.title: Read and write of same register with Ear = Ec+1
points.condition: An AR transfer occurs one edge after the Ec of a write to the same read/write register.

points.title: Status read while i_status changes
points.condition: An AR transfer to the status register occurs at an edge where i_status differs from its value at the previous edge.

points.title: Reset with only write address held
points.condition: At R1, the state at the last edge before reset had a write address held and no write data held.

points.title: Reset with only write data held
points.condition: At R1, the state at the last edge before reset had write data held and no write address held.

points.title: Reset with B response pending
points.condition: At R1, a write response was pending at the last edge before reset.

points.title: Reset with R response pending
points.condition: At R1, a read response was pending at the last edge before reset.

points.title: Write valid held through reset taken as new request
points.condition: awvalid or wvalid was 1 at R1 and the matching transfer occurs at the following edge.

points.title: Read valid held through reset taken as new request
points.condition: arvalid was 1 at R1 and the AR transfer occurs at the following edge.

points.title: Unaligned address bits [1:0] on AW or AR
points.condition: An AW or AR transfer with address bits [1:0] not zero.

points.title: Non-zero AxPROT on AW or AR
points.condition: An AW or AR transfer with awprot or arprot not zero.

points.title: Register write completes while R is stalled
points.condition: Ec of a write to a read/write register occurs while read data is pending with rready 0.
